subject: BrightLayer onboarding: PO issuance, spend cap mismatch & line-item update

Date: Mon, 01 Dec 2025 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Onboarding paperwork + invoice for PO assignment

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the quick intro call this morning. Attached is our completed onboarding form and the initial invoice for the first quarter of service. Two quick items we flagged while preparing the materials:

- The invoice references a single consolidated SKU (BRIGHT-CORE) but your AP team requested separate billing lines for licensing and professional services. Can you confirm if we should break the invoice into two line items (LIC / PS) before you issue the PO?
- On the paperwork we left the requested spend cap at $75,000—your onboarding doc suggested a $60k provisional cap. Please confirm which cap we should expect on the issued PO.

We can send a revised invoice right away if that speeds PO issuance. Do you need any additional fields on the onboarding form to match your procurement system?

Attachments: BrightLayer_OnboardingForm.pdf, BL_Invoice_4532.xlsx

Best,
Elena Marin

Folks — forwarding BrightLayer onboarding. They submitted the form and an invoice but the line-item split and requested cap don't match our standard. Can procurement/finance advise:

- Can we issue a provisional PO with a $60,000 spend cap and later increase after usage review?
- If we need the invoice split into LIC / PS lines, ask vendor to provide revised file so AP can map GL codes.

Priyom — can you propose the PO allocation (ponum + line mapping) we should give in a provisional issuance?
Ben — please confirm what fields AP needs on the invoice to avoid rework.

Thanks — I told them we'd try to get a PO out this week pending the above.

Hi Elena / BrightLayer team — thanks for the packet and heads-up. A couple notes from procurement: 

1) Provisional PO: we can issue a provisional PO with a $60,000 spend cap (standard for new vendors). If you need $75k immediately, we can request a one-time exception but will need a short justification (expected run-rate or milestone timing).

2) Line items: please reissue the invoice with two lines:
   - BRIGHT-CORE-LIC — Qty 1 — Unit price = licensing portion (map to GL 5412)
   - BRIGHT-CORE-PS — Qty 1 — Unit price = implementation/services (map to GL 6220)

This mapping avoids AP rework. Also, include your vendor tax ID and exact bank remittance instructions on the invoice footer. Once we receive the revised invoice (and the signed onboarding pdf), Kimberly/Ben can approve and we will allocate a provisional PO number.

Please attach the revised invoice to this thread so we can track in PROC-1124.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Procurement Specialist | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.example.com

Hi Priyom / Kimberly,

Thanks — attached is the revised invoice (BL_Invoice_4532_revised.xlsx) with two line items and the onboarding form updated to include our tax ID and remittance instructions. We are keeping the total at $75,000 but can accept a provisional cap of $60,000 for initial issuance; please indicate the provisional cap on the PO and we will manage delivery accordingly.

If you need a short business justification for the $75k ask: the professional services portion covers an accelerated setup (3-week engagement) that ships in Q1 and will push usage above the initial threshold in month two. Happy to provide a one-paragraph note if that helps the exception review.

Attachments: BL_Invoice_4532_revised.xlsx, BrightLayer_OnboardingForm.pdf

Best,
Elena Marin

Elena / BrightLayer — thanks for the quick turnaround and the revised invoice. Finance has reviewed:

- PO number issued (provisional): PO-2025-11978
- Provisional spend cap: $60,000 (notation on PO: Provisionally issued; contact procurement for cap increase)
- Line mapping recorded: BRIGHT-CORE-LIC -> GL 5412; BRIGHT-CORE-PS -> GL 6220

Please note: final payment will be processed after the vendor onboarding checklist is complete and the vendor is approved in Coupa. If you want the $75k cap up front, send the one-paragraph justification and we will route to Finance Ops for exception approval (timeline ~3 business days).

I have attached the PO stub to our internal PROC ticket and copied the drive link in PROC-1124.

Thanks — welcome onboard.
